user.title: InPost Login
user.description:
1. Open the [InPost login page]({login_url}) in your browser and sign in (phone number, SMS code, captcha and email confirmation).
2. After logging in, open your browser's developer tools (F12) > Application/Storage > Cookies > `https://account.inpost-group.com`.
3. Copy the value of the `SESSION` cookie (or paste the full cookie string) below.
